about: The sources of this project's subject matter (Mathematik 1 and 2), apart from the design rules' bibliography, which keeps the design principles.

entries.title: Mathematik 1 und 2 (lecture script for electrical engineering)
entries.venue: Lecture script, TU Wien; file Taschner_Skr_mathe1-2.pdf, 505 pages, undated
entries.backs: The mathematics labs: the Babylonian root (pp. 1–3), complex numbers (pp. 92–94), the geometric series (p. 126), lower and upper sums (§ 28, pp. 166–167), secant and tangent (pp. 204–205), uniform convergence and the bumps (pp. 285–288), Newton's formula (p. 308), determinants (§ 59, p. 336), Cramer's rule (p. 400), eigenvectors of a quadratic form (p. 410), Cauchy's integral theorem (p. 493), by printed page. Read from the rendered pages on 2 Nov 2026: the text layer is scrambled. The script itself is undated; the year is the PDF's creation date, 22 June 2013 (modified 5 Nov 2015).
